notes.title: SOUTHAG Update!
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

We have updated WARNO - SOUTHAG with the last two remaining divisions: the NATO’s French Division du Rhin and Warsaw Pact’s Soviet 17-ya Gv. Tank. Diviziya.

Read all the juicy details below.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Official Laucnh
As you might know, WARNO - SOUTHAG has been available in a limited “Early Access” state for the last couple of weeks. We finally managed to squash some persistent bugs and release the two remaining divisions, which comes together with a major balance patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/964d63547fadbc244f297ee4200092598870ba10.png

The full launch of WARNO - SOUTHAG is still to come at an unspecified date in the near future. This official release will also come with the missing Army General campaigns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/76f6f65c198c98fb728f9198ce3aa96446c49485.gif

A major patch and update for WARNO has also been released today. A preview of these changes can be checked here, but this means new “cop” cars (for almost all divisions), new units for the 11e Division Parachutiste and TerrKdo Süd, some reworked models, and a host of other improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/e4386dfd8660a3d2340dee1b125866a2543ed176.jpg

See below for more details:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1611600/announcements/detail/519725729918746951?snr=2___

Ranked Map Pool
We're excited to announce that all recently released 1v1 maps are being added to the pool with today's update! Here's the complete list of new additions:

New Maps:
 Schondra
 Isura
 Taler
 Valley
 Stoneware
 Surrounded
 Eiche
These maps are now being added to the existing pool, no maps are being removed. At the end of this season, you'll have the opportunity to vote for which maps will remain in the next season's rotation.
Get ready to explore new battlefields and develop fresh strategies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/89ee19276bdb89d52de100db13f89c44820d5f42.gif

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978630/WARNO__SOUTHAG/
2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack and Closing the Trap.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or Attrition,Hydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.
Until Next Week
Let us know what you think!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

See you on the battlefield, commanders.

notes.title: A Short Update and a Nemesis Teaser
notes.content:
Hello!

We hope you are doing well. This DevBlog will be a bit shorter than usual, as the Eugen team is knee-deep in fixing several issues related to the upcoming WARNO - SOUTHAG release, including the desync bug.

We know you have been clamoring for the full, official launch, but you need to hold on a little bit longer, as we are almost there.

We did not come completely empty-handed, though.

Keep reading to find out more.

Nemesis #4.3 - Capital Defence
With all the hullabaloo surrounding WARNO - SOUTHAG, it might be easy to forget that we have Nemesis #4.3 - Capital Defence coming your way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/9f41871726399cedfa1f13f3caa958d97ee668d6.png"]It won the popular vote back earlier this year, but just to recap: Nemesis #4.3 - Capital Defence features two formations safeguarding the respective nation’s capital during the Cold War. On NATO’s side, we have the UK’s Home Defence Region London and for the Warsaw Pact, the Soviet 2-ya Tamanskaya Gvardeyskaya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya or the 2nd Guards Tamanskaya Motorized Rifle Division based in Moscow, USSR.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/99fae213acb15a171e5d3f314f763f2dcbdcde90.jpg"]We can let you know that our 3D modellers and artists are doing big chunks of work on Nemesis #4.3 in the background. Below are some fruits of their labor.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/fdc295bbe48caa0f2cb1569b1301e22d3a0f9ac9.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/3fa88621c98353265329c45819e9acbf7776c2ac.jpg"]
WARNO League Season 5
We also take this opportunity to shine a light on Protosz's upcoming WARNO LEAGUE SEASON 4. Here is what he has to say about it:

The most prestigious WARNO Tournament is coming back again at the end of September and you all can be part of it! 

WARNO League Season 5 will start at the 29th of September into its group stage, following the well established format of the previous seasons of 4 Divisions based on skill level! 

So no matter if you are new to WARNO 1v1 or a Veteran, you will have good and fair matches! Sign up and information can be found here: https://playsdl.com/tournament/warno-league-season5

We are also going to improve the experience compared to previous seasons.

As we are working on improving the Fantasy league, the pick and ban System and the Stats collection to make it more fun for both players and Viewers!

So sign up now if you want to be a part of it! Slots are filling up quickly!

That said, WARNO League Season 4 Grandfinals was one, if not the best final we had so far!

All of you who missed it can find the VOD here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/live/pzoe3u3-QBY?feature=share"][/dynamiclink]

The Event will be streamed through out its run from September to November on YT and twitch:  

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyjoKrrlMzU9QZb26-8yg0A"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/sd_league"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: A Host of Upcoming Unit Updates
notes.content:
Hello commanders!

We are back again. As you know, last week we launched our new expansion, WARNO - SOUTHAG into a preliminary “Early Access” available to Expansion Pass owners.

We promise: the full official release of WARNO - SOUTHAG is coming very soon.

In the meantime, in today’s DevBlog, we look at several new units that have been added, improved or will be added to existing divisions in WARNO thanks to WARNO - SOUTHAG.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Early Access
We have released WARNO - SOUTHAG into an “Early Access” form, meaning that owners of the WARNO Expansion Pass will be able to already play with our newest expansion. Why?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/dd5e708d90772b259a6ad7f82d98812c978ef88b.png

After several months of unexpected delays in getting our expansion out of the door, we wanted to give our players and community a chance to get playing sooner rather than later. The roadblocks and issues derailed WARNO - SOUTHAG’s development significantly, and - for us and for you - it was high time you got playing, while we are working our darndest to get the missing content from the expansion into the official full launch. WARNO - SOUTHAG is currently without the last two divisions and one Army General campaign.

In the meantime, we wanted to give you an overview of all the new, updated, or changed units that - thanks to WARNO - SOUTHAG you’ll be able to encounter in the WARNO base game.

New and Improved Units
With France arguably being one of the main NATO protagonists in WARNO - SOUTHAG, we modeled several new units for the Army General campaign. These will also find their way into existing French divisions, specifically the 11e Division Parachutiste and 4e Division Aéromobile (the latter attached to the West German Territorialkommando Süd in-game).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/24bd563adad3888d7d76ffbdd9e4844b5b631762.png

New, reworked, or improved units are highlighted in bold and italic.

11e Division Parachutiste
A new P4 PC PARA., with the Para (meaning Forward Deployment) trait. This unit replaces the previous, regular P4 PC.
In the same vein, a new HM2A1 105mm PARA., with the Para (Forward Deployment) trait. This one replaces the previous, regular HM2A1 105mm.
One card of PARA. ECLAIREURS is replaced with one new HUSSARDS PARA., a more heavily armed 8-man recon squad. The former are now restricted to the P4 (no more VLRA .50), but in turn, gain access to the new recon transport P4 ANF1, meanwhile, the latter are restricted to the VLRA and  VLRA.50.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/a81d0bc33026e8ff306b8096fdb31d4cd48d546d.jpg

TerrKdo Süd
The new AUVERLAND jeeps were only used by the 4e Division Aéromobile, intended to be airlifted onto the battlefield. In-game, they'll have the same stats as their P4 counterpart, but with the Airlifted trait.

The P4 MILAN is replaced with the AUVERLAND MILAN, with access to the SUPER PUMA as a transport option.
Added one card of command AUVERLAND PC, once again with access to SUPER PUMA as a transport.
Added the new 4-man AERO-ECLAIREURS with either the transport AUVERLAND or the recon transport AUVERLAND ANF-1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/19b6e1759c427f86284a306d3e5748367cedceb1.jpg

Reworked Models
While modelling new variants of existing units, we also took the opportunity to update the base models in case of visual… imperfections. This includes:

The West German LEOPARD 1A1A1, which gave birth to 1. Luftlandedivision’s “healthy” LEOPARD 1A1A2.
The Soviet BM-21 GRAD, which happens to be the proud father of Soviet 31-ya TD's PRIMA. Not only that, we also redid some of the textures for this venerable artillery unit, specifically the Polish and East German variants, which either had Soviet markings or the wrong tone of camouflage green. These have been fixed with the proper national colors and markings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/72be8da3ca460b02eaa9d8fc01af2f537954b270.jpg

Call 911
And, furthermore, we took the chance to expand the number of “cop cars” in WARNO. That is, the military police vehicles with their own Military Police  trait. This means that units previously restricted to specific divisions, depending on their DLC, have been seeded more generously throughout the game.

M1025 HUMVEE MP is now available in most American divisions.
The new P4 GENDARMERIE in French formations.
The new VW T3 FELDJÄGER in West German battlegroups.
And the ROVER KMAR and ROVER PREVOTE in Dutch and Belgian divisions respectively.
We will round out this list after WARNO - SOUTHAG’s full release:

The new TRAFIC GENDARMERIE (to be featured in the Division du Rhin) will also be made available in 152e Division d’Infanterie.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/2b99391da939e0a763a28af6bbd912ac8d6dc7be.jpg
The new UAZ-452 in some Soviet and Polish divisions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/2a413771b097b97e22f651719f92c10c975bfacb.jpg

Already added
Furthermore, the following changes were already added to the base game of WARNO with last week’s patch:

A new MiG-21bis [AT] to the Polish 4 Dywizja Zmechanizowana, which was in need of some anti-tank capacity.
Plus we replaced one card of PARA. MARINE from 11e Division Parachutiste with one card of new PARA. MARINE (Eryx), representing the 8e RPIMa which was the designated regiment testing the Eryx ATGM since 1988. As we are “Marching to War” the Eryx for Canada, there was no reason for it not to be featured with this French division who was actually field testing this short-range SACLOS missile.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier. The expansion is available now only for Expansion Pass owners. The official launch of WARNO - SOUTHAG will come in the very near future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978630/WARNO__SOUTHAG/

2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack and Closing the Trap.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or Attrition,Hydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.

Until Next Week
We’ll be back soon!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

notes.title: SOUTHAG Available Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello commanders!

It’s a very special day today. It’s high time you guys got to play with WARNO - SOUTHAG!

Our latest expansion for WARNO is now available in Early Access for all WARNO Expansion Pass owners.

Wait, what, you might say? While you're downloading, read on for an explanation.

Early Access for Expansion Owners
Let’s cut straight to the point: WARNO - SOUTHAG has seen some significant delays, slipping from an original Q2 release date to almost the tail-end of Q3. And the simple truth was that we didn’t want our players to wait any longer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/dd5e708d90772b259a6ad7f82d98812c978ef88b.png

There are a variety of reasons for the delays encountered, which we’ll highlight below, but suffice to say that we wanted to get WARNO - SOUTHAG out of the door, sooner rather than later. But, an important consideration, not everything was fully ready to go.

That’s why we made the executive decision to release WARNO - SOUTHAG in “Early Access” - with some specific content missing - only for Expansion Pass owners, with a full release coming in the very near future.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Early Access
So, what does this mean? Well, first off: WARNO - SOUTHAG can now be played by all owners of the Expansion Pass. They will have almost complete access to the expansion:

8 out of 10 Divisions (see below)
4 out of 4 Operations.
But no Army General campaign.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/59d5b017e752f20084abc4eec2c861756f05e9d8.gif

NATO's available divisions are:
División Meca. Brunete n°1
6e Division Légère Blindée
1. Luftlande-Division
1st Canadian Division
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/6b2d4f9cff7358ea5030cbdfc7254c8e5aa9d4ee.png

Pact's available divisions are:
31-ya Tank. Div.
1. Tanková Divize

Game localization in Spanish, Chinese & German haven't been integrated yet, nor are the voice acting for the operations' ingame dialogs.
All missing content will be added at the official public release of WARNO - SOUTHAG.

On top of the above content, we will also release three new maps to all owners of WARNO for free! Check out a preview here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/959de7cb25a6ddffa346af56e3edda62612af272.jpg

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Delays
At this point, many of WARNO - SOUTHAG’s moving parts were ready to go, except for some important elements, including the massive Army General campaign. In order not to have any more delays, we decided to launch the expansion now, even if it is a little incomplete. Our overriding objective is for you to start playing, while we cross our t’s and dot our i’s in the background.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/9d824df9f879ace4659f593ad7396c6171f48ea4.jpg

The development of WARNO - SOUTHAG didn’t go as smoothly as we had expected or hoped for. There were lots of little things piled up, from a small but hard-working team finalizing multiple projects at the same time, to rather pesky bugs that required substantially more resources to squash than initially forecast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/86f3ad69615f87a9f78d8403b81130ac4591cec9.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d20e2f5620da5259bc7ff0aaf6bb481674ab757e.jpg

notes.title: New Maps Coming in Hot!
notes.content:
Hello commanders!

We hope you are well. First things first: we know many of you have been waiting very patiently, and eagerly, for our next upcoming expansion, WARNO - SOUTHAG. And yes, it has been delayed, and the wait over the summer has been long, but we promise we are very close to giving our WARNO players the good stuff.

However, as we don’t want to overpromise, we need to hold back on the info for a tiny-teeny bit longer. Details are forthcoming, but our biggest priority now is to get our players something to play with ASAP.

That also includes not one, not two, but three new maps!

Three New WARNO Battlefields

Isura
This 4x2 map is inspired by the topography on the outskirts of Regensburg, West Germany. It combines the charm of Bavaria with its rugged mountainous terrain, while a large, winding river snakes its way through the map. This battlefield offers a host of open combat zones, ideal for mechanized warfare, as well as great for long-range artillery duels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/579e0f00b6573300086ae4c6ae08adf6808632bf.jpg

Isura features a variety of different corridors, filled with several urban zones. These will need intricate infantry-centered tactics to overcome and dominate.

Isura will be available at launch in 1vs1 Duel, 3vs3, and 10vs10.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/db1f97de177077c7b30d34515937e69ba1cd31a5.jpg

Taler
Taking its cues from the surroundings around Huderdorf’s outskirts, a West German region with a richly varied landscape, the 4x3 Taler battlefield features a mix of open fields, dense woods, and rolling hills. Every division should find a piece of terrain on Taler in which they will excel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/ceab7ac943a71c26e2d5fc849a8bddc31364255e.jpg

Much like Isura, this map is designed from the ground up for large-scale battles up to 10v10, but will also be available in 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/966be82660dc5f71e4bbe6b4a9550258d90d14b8.jpg

Schondra
Schondra, a 2x3 map, is the follow-up to the Ohmen map, in which - if you recall - we introduced a new PvP-focused “Mirror” map approach. This new map is also designed specifically with competitive play in mind, relying on symmetry in its road layout, defensive points, and distribution of buildings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/959de7cb25a6ddffa346af56e3edda62612af272.jpg

To avoid an overly artificial look, each side of the map is slightly adjusted. We have modified some of the assets, meaning that the map still looks organic enough but doesn’t introduce any strategic or tactical imbalances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/e9bd04fc8ea2425217f006baa7bdffc801db9962.jpg

Schondra will be available in 1v1 Duel and 2v2.

Updated WARNO Maps
Next to the arrival of the above three new maps, we also took some time to update our existing maps to be able to accommodate more modes. These changes will be rolled out at the same time the new maps will become available - when WARNO - SOUTHAG releases.

Destruction

2x2_Tension_2vs2_DEST
2x3_Albion_Military_Base_2vs2_DEST
2x2_Hesse_2vs2_DEST
2x2_Teuflesmoor_2vs2_DEST
3x3_UrbanFrontlines_3vs3_DEST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/ef04fa14fac6bc6b827f19baf28568d1be035ff8.jpg

Conquest

3x3_Eiche_2vs2_CONQ

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/89ee19276bdb89d52de100db13f89c44820d5f42.gif

Duel Conquest

3x3_Valley_1vs1_CONQ_DUEL
3x3_Stoneware_1vs1_CONQ_DUEL
3x3_Factory_1vs1_CONQ_DUEL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/afd1123cee89c9870befc8b49027a80258c73af2.jpg

WARNO LEAGUE Grand Final
At Eugen, we gladly support any kind of community effort, especially when it comes to competitive play. Dear Protosz has mounted another banger of a match, with the upcoming WARNO LEAGUE SEASON 4 Grand Final.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d5962d74e15f7defc830d63d7cf64d6b84b72648.png

Two of the most prestigious competitive players in WARNO history are set to battle it out. With Tmanplays and Pro Kommyhuct two former WARNO LEAGUE Champions are facing each other in an epic Best of Five!

If you want to check out some spectacular WARNO battles, come join this Saturday, the 23rd of August, at 1:30 pm GMT. The whole event will be streamed live on SDL Twitch’s channel, as well as on Youtube. More info on the event can be found here.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

In the southern reaches of Germany, the Warsaw Pact with the Soviet Central Group of Forces, bolstered by the communist Czechoslovakians, battles against a counter-attacking NATO SOUTHAG command led by France, with American, West German, Canadian, and reinforcing Spanish troops.


2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack and Closing the Trap.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or Attrition,Hydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.


Until Next Week
We’ll be back very shortly with more exciting news. Not long now, commanders!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

See you on the battlefield.

AMX-13 T75: Light tank mounting both a 75mm gun and SS.11 wire-guided missiles.

notes.content:

Let’s go! 

Unit Preview
This week, we took four among NATO divisions to be featured in WARNO - SOUTHAG and picked the most interesting units from each. Check out the video below. As you know, we are finalizing the last bits and bobs on our new expansion, which we hope to launch soon (but no release date yet)! 

[previewyoutube=E75atMApoVY;full][/previewyoutube]

The following divisions you’ll be able to spot in the video, plus their most noteworthy units:

1st Canadian Division

ERYX: An accurate, portable anti-tank weapon system.
COUGAR: Fast APC equipped with a 76mm gun. In WARNO available in tank, reconnaissance, and command variants.
GRIZZLY: Highly mobile and versatile APC designed for rapid transport.
CL-89: High-speed tactical recon drone. Great for swift battlefield intel. 
ADATS: Unique unit in WARNO. This vehicle combines both advanced anti-air and anti-tank weapons.
CH-135 AT: Helicopter specialized in anti-tank role with rockets. These rockets will also feature on a variant of the CF-18.

notes.title: SOUTHAG Operation #4: Siegfried's Wrath
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

It is good to be back. Hot on the heels of the free Reinforcement Pack 11#: Low Countries' Lions’ release, gifting two new NATO divisions to all owners of WARNO, we return to WARNO - SOUTHAG with a preview of the last Operation to be featured in our new expansion: Siegfried's Wrath.

Let’s go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/7d8a974b0571b24dd0eee35bc134c13c2056c3bf.gif

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Siegfried's Wrath
Siegfried's Wrath is the last of the four Operations of our new expansion. Like the other scenarios, they center around a strategic counter-strike by NATO against a wavering Warsaw Pact set near the Czechoslovakian frontier in southern West Germany.

Siegfried's Wrath takes place on June 26th, meaning it is chronologically the first Operation within the WARNO - SOUTHAG timeline. Featuring the West German 1. Luftlande-Division, it shows the initial NATO actions in the campaign to push the Czechoslovaks back across the Iron Curtain.

[previewyoutube=AuidGtsK1rY;full](insérer vidéo Steph en lien plus haut)[/previewyoutube]

After the initial strikes by the Warsaw Pact, the Czechoslovak People’s Army didn’t advance much deeper into West Germany, hesitant to leave the protective air cover and nearby support of the Soviet Central Group of Forces. NATO, desperate to regain the initiative, launches the air assault in order to establish a bridgehead across the Danube near Deggendorf. Once established, this bridgehead will serve as the West German and Canadian fixing attacks as depicted in the Army General campaign Holding Attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/ebaa507f9139164e05b073fa30dc46803235c9b1.jpg

Siegfried's Wrath detailed
Siegfried's Wrath is a large-scale surprise attack mounted by the West German 1. Luftlande-Division. As a commander, you have been awarded the command of the offensive’s recon and support units, tasked with leading the division to success on the battlefield. Mind you, the forces available to you are limited in size and power. You mostly get to play with recon teams, artillery batteries, attack helicopters, and close air support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/26686617277fc93a82f0442e596c8f19293d68e7.jpg

The challenge in this Operation isn’t the assault itself, but instead supporting the unfolding attack with accurate battlefield reconnaissance and prompt use of artillery fires to destroy enemy positions. The AI controls the main West German force on the ground; as a commander, you take charge of the recon and supporting arms. As such, you need to deploy your scout units smartly, identify enemy defensive points, and pave the way for the offensive. This also means providing artillery support and smoke when needed. Furthermore, if heavy armor shows up, attack helos and airstrikes can neutralize even the deadliest of enemy threats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/a93fc4585e15083a073aa4049b4c5f61875b75b4.jpg

You’ll have to monitor the frontline throughout the mission. The communists will fight back, and the units under your command are light and vulnerable if caught. Breakthroughs need to be reinforced, counterattacks beaten back. You only get a limited amount of units, which means some tough decisions in the field. However, your battlefield conduct in Siegfried's Wrath will prove pivotal in determining the success or failure of the mission, especially as enemy reinforcements will start pouring in to crush the bridgehead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/58272aabc37b18d48b5e118edc8d7430307659b4.gif

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion In Short

notes.title: RP10 and RP11 Low Countries' Lions available
notes.content:
Hello!

As we announced earlier this week, WARNO - SOUTHAG hasn't released in Q2 2025 has originally planned. We just need a bit more time to polish it before release, and apologize for the delay.

Yet, to make amend, we are releasing today two new free contents to help you wait a bit more.

More details below.

Reinforcement Pack #10 and 11
As of now, you can download two new free contents:
 Reinforcement Pack #10, the new map Eiche, inspired by the outskirts of Hamburg and already showcased in a previous DevBlog.
 Reinforcement Pack #11, called Low Countries' Lions, a brand new RP we crafted especially for this occasion,. It features two new NATO divisions: the Belgian DivMob, which we detailed earlier this week, and the Dutch CLKA.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/18b9a524052c3143a5c4702dc8e61f5090f350fa.jpg"]

Both Reinforcement Pack are available as you read this lines.

Freeze and black screen issues
We wanted to give you a quick update about the freeze and black screen issues that some of you might still be running into in WARNO. We know this has been a recurring topic, and we’re keeping a close eye on it.

The “good” news is that the latest NVIDIA graphics drivers have helped reduce these problems for a lot of players. Plus, with the introduction of the Vulkan graphics API, available right in your in-game graphics settings, you might notice fewer issues, or even see them disappear entirely, depending on your setup. 

Rest assured, we are still actively working to resolve these issues and improve your experience. If you’re still having trouble, we recommend giving Vulkan a try (which we have further improved with today’s update) and making sure your graphics drivers are up to date.

Follow these simple steps to activate Vulkan :
[olist]
Open the Options menu from the main screen.
Navigate to the Video section.
Find the Graphic API setting.
Select Vulkan from the list.
Restart the game to apply the changes.
[/olist]
Keep in mind that the Vulkan backend is still considered experimental and may not yet match the performance of the DirectX11 backend. 
(We’re always looking for feedback, so don’t hesitate to let us know if Vulkan has solved any issues for you!)

Thanks for your patience and for all your feedback!

Dedicated Servers Are Here
We are excited to announce that dedicated servers are now available! As with our previous games, you can host your own server, customize it to your liking, and make it visible to the entire community.

But that’s not all.
You can now run servers with mods enabled, whether they’re gameplay mods, new maps, or any other custom content. We’ve updated the game to make this experience as smooth as possible:

 Servers with mods are clearly marked in the server list.
 If you already have the required mods installed: The game will restart, activate the necessary mods, and automatically join the server.
 If you don’t have the required mods: The game will prompt you to subscribe and install them, then restart and connect you to the server.

This new system makes multiplayer modding easier than ever. We can’t wait to see what you create and share, enjoy!
Please note: there is one limitation, servers running a custom map mod will only be visible to players who have that specific mod enabled.

For those interested in hosting a server, you’ll find everything you need right here: Docker Eugen Systems Warno

Today, we will shine some light on the new Dutch Commando LegerKorpsAchtergebied.

The CLKA Historical Background
The Koninklijke Landmacht’s CLKA stands for the beautifully named Commando LegerKorpsAchtergebied which translates to “Rear Area Command”, which for you and our sanity’s sake we have shortened to CLKA. This particular formation was a war-activated divisional command which would have been created as part of the Dutch (NORTHAG-based) 1 (NL) Corps to help secure the rear area of the three Dutch fighting divisions closer to the front (the 1., 4. and 5e Divisie).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/b18d1a3ff1f45c2e3d6c87face63858f7c02c154.jpg

The main component of the division was the 101. Infanteriebrigade. Although filled with reservists historically, these would have been from the most recent batch of demobilized soldiers, meaning they would still be fit and relatively up to date in their training. As such, the brigade’s soldiers are considered regulars in WARNO.

The 101. Infanteriebrigade’s commander was also the de facto commander of the CLKA, and controlled four infantry battalions, half of them mechanized with the AIFV. The other two battalions were truck-borne in real life, but in our alternative timeline, they have been equipped with the trademark Dutch YP-408 wheeled APC (just retired from service) to enhance their firepower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/7334d17e9defbbece528414ef4f01a4a5002cf19.jpg

Another permanently assigned unit was the VerkBat 105, a recon battalion similarly filled with recently demobilized reservists. They are also treated as regulars in-game.

As with other rear-area command divisions, the CLKA also safeguards the corps’ heavy artillery guns and long-range anti-air SAM units, which will duly be represented in the division’s ranks. Lastly, all sorts of security troops would be making their way from the Netherlands to the front, and to patrol and secure the transit areas in between. These range from elite commandos to security militias, and will also be featured within the division.

The CLKA in WARNO
How will the CLKA look like in WARNO? New units are both italic and bolded. Some units are new to this nation, but can be found with other NATO armies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/93c30ecf9d2513aaede6801209dbbf51af2be539.png

LOG
Average, starting with a number of cheap slots, before availability becomes more expensive. The usual supply units are a FOB, plus medium DAF-4400 VRACHT and heavy DAF YHZ-2300 VRACHT supply trucks.
Command units include the new M38A1 CMG jeep (which is the Korean War's variant of the venerable World War II-era Willys jeep), the new YP-408 PWCO wheeled command APC, and the YPR-765 PRCO-C1.

INF
A pretty solid category, although with more expensive slots compared to a regular infantry division. The CLKA can be considered an outsized brigade with additional attached security troops.
The core of the division’s infantry comes from the 101. Infanteriebrigade, which in itself is represented in a variety of units:
PANTSERINF. mechanized infantry squads which deploy in all the same variants as the 4e Divisie. They ride in soft-skin vehicles and YPR-765 PRI.50, which is the .50 cal variant, not the 25mm one.
The new INFANTERIE are larger 9-man squads with FAL and MAG, plus either LAW or Carl Gustav recoilless rifles. The leader variant is an even bigger 10-strong squad with Uzi, FAL, LAW, and smoke grenades. These troops can deploy in soft-skin vehicles and the YP-408 PWI, the Dutch iconic wheeled APC, predecessor to the YPR-765.
NATRES reservist squads are also present, deployable in trucks, YP-408 PWI, and the YPR-765 PRI.50. These squads represent the less-trained reservists of the division.
They are further backed by the RES. GENIE combat engineers with Uzis, MAG, and satchel charges, plus the Reservist trait.
Support units include (new to the nation) M40A1, the new DRAGON I and (new to the Dutch) I-TOW anti-tank teams. The DRAGON team is special, as it is a very cheap 2-man short-ranged ATGM team.
Plus MAG 7,62mm machine gun teams, and TANKJAGERS anti-tank squad with two Carl Gustav. The M38A1C M40A1 is deployable as a fire-support jeep.
The infantry is further reinforced by a wide array of security units:
BEVEILIGING squads are security troops, more on the level of militia, brought over from Dutch soil. These are 9-strong squads with Uzi, Garand, and L4A4 (modernized World War 2-era Bren LMGs) with the Reservist and Security traits. The best of the bunch are gathered into BEVEILIGING MOBIEL with Uzi, FAL, two FALO, and a MAG, and no Reservist trait. BEVEILIGING CMG is their 7-man leader variant with Uzis, an L4A4, and an M20 Super Bazooka, another weapon of Korean War's vintage. These squads come in soft-skin vehicles only.
To keep the reservist rabble in line, the MARECHAUSSEE is present, in M38A1 NEKAF and ROVER KMAR transports (itself with the Military Police trait), but also as the new MARECHAUSSEE (MAG) squad, which is a 12-man unit with Uzis and a MAG and the Military Police trait, deployable in DAF trucks and VW T3 KMAR minibus (with Military Police trait).
MARECHAUSSEE CMG are 4-man leader squads with Uzis, MAG and M20 Super Bazooka, also riding in M38A1 NEKAF and the new ROVER KMAR.
Finally, the new COMMANDO RES. squads. Tasked with tracking down enemy special forces behind enemy lines, these are veteran 11-man squads with FAL, one scoped FAL, 2x MAG and LAW, plus the Special Forces, Shock and Security traits. The leader variant is the COMMANDO CMG, which is an 8-strong unit with Uzis, 2x L4A4, LAW, and smoke grenades, and comes with the same traits as their regular infantry squad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/ba63381f474443611189d3d696248b4e12eebcab.png

ART
Pretty good, if we look at the availability of the units and their price. The 101. Infanteriebrigade could only count on some lighter (new to this division and nation) M30 107mm.
Heavier corps artillery pieces include the (again new to this nation) M101 105mm, the brand-new M114/39 155mm, (new to the nation) M110A2 203mm and (new to the Dutch) M270 MLRS. The last two units are armed with cluster munitions.

TANK
Pretty good for a reservist division, in terms of costs and slots, but all the units mentioned here will come in one card.
The only organic tanks assigned to the CLKA were the LEOPARD 2A4(B) featured by its recon battalion.
The CLKA would have been in the collecting area for vehicles transitioning to and from the front (for instance, as replenishment or for repair). In case of an immediate threat, any in working order, would have been commandeered by the CLKA. As such, the division gets a few (new) LEOPARD 1V (in vanilla and CMG command variant), as well as older CENTURION MK.5/2.
Anti-tank units include the new M38A1 TOW, the YP-408 PWAT (with a single I-TOW launcher) and the YPR-765 PRAT (with twin TOW-2 launcher).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/56dd037d2eaecbc5a298cbc335d3a21ffbbf02d1.jpg

REC
Pretty good, in terms of price and availability, primarily thanks to the inclusion of its own recon battalion, the VerkBat 105. The CLKA has a good number of recon troops and vehicles at its disposal.
Infantry scouts include:
VERKENNERS squads deployable in M38A1 NEKAF, the new M38A1 VERK.) with an M1191 MG (counts as a recon vehicle), and ALOUETTE.
The new PANTSERVERKENNERS, a stronger 8-man recon squad with FAL, MAG, and Carl Gustav recoilless rifles, coming trucks and the new M113A1 VERK. (counts a recon vehicle).
Recon vehicles include:
The M113 C&V and the new M113 C&V KMAR, a military police (Koninklijke Marechaussee) variant of the same armored vehicle, armed with an M2HB 12,7mm HMG and featuring the Military Police trait next to its recon ability.
The new YP-408 PWRDR, an unarmed radar recon variant of the wheeled APC.
Air recon includes the ALOUETTE III, but also the new BO-105 CB MINIGUN. A few later models of this helicopter were equipped with this particular weapon in real life (pictures exist), but nothing was known of their official designation or where they were deployed. The new unit will see the light in WARNO under this made-up name.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/94356c23b0b9789718d35f1df34504cd09aecd90.jpg

AA
Same as the above categories, being pretty good in terms of slots and their prices. The division did not have any organic anti-air units, but as a rear-area command, it safeguarded heavier corps assets, which will be represented in this category.
BOFORS 40L70G and STINGER MANPAD teams.
I-HAWK SAM.
A few old M55 MAXSON quad-12,7mm of World War II vintage.
The Americans forward-deployed troops from the 2nd Armored Division in the area the CLKA is guarding, waiting for the rest of the division to be airlifted in. Among the troops already on the ground are a select number of helicopters, which grants the division a single card of OH-58C/S as anti-air attachment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/cf263d001b10af58d433a5cf1540263857d2c558.jpg

HEL
Mediocre, with few options and expensive slots. The Dutch Armed Forces in the late 1980s didn’t have any attack helicopters. Furthermore, the CLKA was not a priority when it came to close air helo support. The only available choppers will be called upon from nearby NATO allied units.
These include West German BO-105 PAH-1.
And American AH-1F HOGs.

AIR
Average.The Koninklijke Luchtmacht helps out with the Dutch NF-5A in HE, the new NPLM loadout, and CLU, as well as F-16A in an AA2 variant.
American F-4E PHANTOM II [AA], plus the F-4G WILD WEASEL V [SEAD] will also be available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/4fdb8f43d06ded48ec71f4502950a2c4a7946d12.jpg

The CLKA is a well-rounded rear-area division, without any major drawbacks, but also without any specific strengths. Unlike other similar divisions in-game, which rely on masses of reservists, this division is mostly composed of regular units and capable mechanized forces.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

In the southern reaches of Germany, the Warsaw Pact with the Soviet Central Group of Forces, bolstered by the communist Czechoslovakians, battles against a counter-attacking NATO SOUTHAG command led by France, with American, West German, Canadian, and reinforcing Spanish troops.

notes.title: SOUTHAG Delay plus RP11 Low Countries' Lions #1
notes.content:
Hello!

Get ready for some important news with today’s DevBlog; specifically in regard to the (late) delivery of WARNO - SOUTHAG.

And we don’t come empty-handed. As an apology of sorts, we will deliver a free Reinforcement Pack to feature two new NATO divisions in the near future.

Lots to explain, so let’s dive in straight away.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Delays
Well, well, well, Eugen meets again its nemesis: the wickedest of all… time! Yes, we know, this is not the first moment that we encountered delays with one of our projects. The road of game development can be long, complex, and quite bumpy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/bfdfcda7890215651bfdf1348c54d69c69789430.gif

As we have wrestled with hiccups or changes in schedule before, a disclaimer of sorts: Eugen is a small, dedicated, independent game studio with a hard-working team that does their damndest to get everything out the door as soon as possible. However, game dev involves delays, things not working out, other issues, bugs, etc., which means that we can’t always deliver what we promised on time. Such is the case with WARNO - SOUTHAG.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/76e3503c6221168efa6d86d15fa2cc1fcb89ea6e.gif

We originally announced that WARNO expansion would be delivered by Q2 of 2025 (meaning April to June). Clearly, we have not made this deadline. WARNO - SOUTHAG is delayed, though we are working very hard to get the new expansion into your hands as soon as possible.

Of course, we want to make up for this. You know Eugen, we might not be able to deliver on time, but we do owe up. As an “apology” to our community, and to make sure there is not too much restless waiting, we will release the already announced Reinforcement Pack #10, that is the new map Eiche, but also extra content in the the form of a Reinforcement Pack #11.

Reinforcement Pack #11
A little bit more detail: Reinforcement Pack #11 contains two divisions with a host of new units. These were chiefly made for WARNO - NORTHAG: some only featured in our Army General campaigns, others had remained unused for they fitted neither AG not our multiplayer division. On top of that, we fleshed the divisions with some new models build purposedly for this RP. 
This particular offering would have been, somewhat unfairly, overlooked had we put them through a Nemesis vote. At the same time, due to the content and theme, being able to offer them as a free Reinforcement Pack #11 makes now even more sense!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/b8ac12fd2a49c40095aa04f163f3dfab0d2bb59f.png

So, what are you going to get?

RP #11 - Low Countries’ Lions
Reinforcement Pack #11 will be called Low Countries’ Lions and will feature two (yup) NATO divisions: the Dutch Commando Legerkorpsachtergebied (or CLKA), and the Belgian Division Mobilisation (or DivMob). As you can see, two NATO rear-area formations with a rather interesting make-up and plenty of unique equipment. The name stems from the fact that the Netherlands and Belgium both share the Leo Belgicus in their coat of arms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/6b2a934585dd6664fe7a364dfe4c0a10057827e5.png

For the Dutch CLKA, you’ll get among other things the new in-game YP-408 series of APC, the Dutch trademark Cold War workhorse, which was in real life retired in 1989, just before our war scenario. In our alternative history, they would have been passed to another “lesser active” unit and seen the light within this battlegroup. Although a rear-area command, this division doesn't rely as extensively on reservists as other similar ones.

As for the Belgian DivMob, a treasure trove of original weaponry awaits. Belgium might not have been the most modernly equipped NATO ally, but it has a special profile among Western armies: it didn’t throw anything away. Much like the Soviets, the Belgians kept hundreds of armored vehicles, APCs, SPGs, and even tanks in storage. This new division will give them plenty of opportunity to shine.

We will highlight first the Belgian DivMob today, and the Dutch CLKA later this week.

The DivMob’s Historical Background
The Belgian Division Mobilisation, or in-game the DivMob, was an administrative - not field - command of the Belgian Armed Forces. All mobilized troops and equipment would be processed through this formation before final assignment to an active unit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/e6fbe4723d3b2fd5fb808a8ccad42cc3f67f0a31.png

While the Dutch CLKA is a rear-area command in the field, the DivMob is instead a division created from interior troops, used in the case of an enemy breakthrough of NATO’s main line of defense. This formation would also have been deployed if the communists had ever invaded Belgian territory or dropped airborne troops over the country.

In this way, the DivMob acted as a divisional headquarters and commanded a combat group from Belgium’s Interior Forces, which included:

9x Territorial regiments, forming the core of the DivMob.
3x Regular light infantry regiments, acting as interior mobile reserves.
4x Engineer battalions, plus independent companies.
Reservists.
Gendarmes, including the Royal Belgian Gendarmerie’s armored squadron.
Heavy AA and artillery units.
Lots of other equipment in storage, some of it coming out of long-term warehouses. This ranges from APCs, self-propelled guns, and tanks, all of which are to be manned by reservists.

Ultimately, although fielding older equipment, the DivMob is a mechanized formation at more levels than its active field-duty combat division counterparts.

The DivMob in WARNO
How will the DivMob look like in WARNO - SOUTHAG? New units are both italic and bolded. Some units are new to this nation, but can be found with NATO in other armies. The following might be subject to change.

LOG
A good category, as can be expected from this type of division.
For supplies, you can deploy an FOB, the (new to this nation) UNIMOG S404 LOG, and heavy VOLVO N10 LOG. supply trucks, as well as the few Belgian Navy's SEA KING supply helicopters, deploying in their cool-looking livery.
Command units include the ILTIS PC jeep, as well as the armored (new) AMX-13 MOD.56 PC and M75 PC. The former is the command variant of the French AMX-13 VCI APC, while the latter is a heavy American APC from the Korean War, the first of a family that will spawn the M59 and M113 later on.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/918d48bc4fdd790b1d65bae45c878a2c74340765.jpg

INF
A very good category, with the DivMob having all the hallmarks of an infantry division.
The core of the battlegroup will be formed by PROVINCIAUX, Belgian territorial troops. These are 12-strong squads equipped with FAL, 1x FALO and an M20 Super Bazooka, plus the Reservist trait. They come in either trucks or M75 AIV with a .50 cal machine gun. The CMDT PROVINCIAUX is the leader variant, being a 10-strong squad with 4x PM Vigneron, 5x FAL, 1x FALO and smoke grenades, with the same Reservist trait and transport option.
To keep the reservists in check, PREVOTE in ILTIS and ROVER PREVOTE (with Military Police trait) and blue-dressed GENDARMES, 10-strong with PM Vigneron, FAL and 2x FALO and the Military Police trait are available. Aside from trucks, the latter unit can deploy in two dedicated Military Police vehicles: the VW T3 GENDARMERIE minivan and BDX Irish-made APC, armed with 2x MAG machine guns.
The combat engineer battalions are represented as the PIONIER (regular, RL-83 recoilless rifle, and leader variants), the same as the Belgian 16de Pantserdivisie (part of WARNO - NORTHAG), in softskin vehicles or AMX-13 MOD.56 VCI APCs.
To represent the three regular light infantry regiments, we used the CHASSEURS ARDENNAIS (even though in real-life, they only amount to one of the three regiments) primarily for their World War I and World War II fame… and their cool looks. These are 8-man strong squads, with FNC, 2x MAG and LAW, plus the Security trait, deployable in trucks. Their CMDT CHASSEURS ARDENNAIS leader variant are 4-strong with 3x FNC, 1x scoped Model 30-11, a Blindicide RL-83 and smoke grenades, with access to both trucks or the AIFV-B-50.
The RES. PARA-COMMANDO represents the depot's 4th (Reserve) Para-Commando Bataillon, which wasn’t featured in the MNAD battlegroup (of WARNO - NORTHAG) as was the rest of the regiment. As reserve paratroopers, this unit doesn’t receive the Reservist trait, to reflect the higher standards of training, but does lose the Shock trait of their more active counterparts. This unit is an 8-strong squad with FNC, 2x FALO and Blindicide RL-100, plus the Airborne trait's Forward Deployment. They can deploy in UNIMOG UI350L or UNIMOG UI350L PARA. trucks.
Support units featured are MAG 7,62mm, MILAN 1, and PARA. MILAN 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/f28d56033be8159fcb056a2e8d2e2b2d4ac787a2.png

ART
Very good, with lots of guns, and plenty of self-propelled guns in storage. This category is also not too expensive, with a good number of slots.
The Belgian territorial and light infantry’s fire support is restricted to the US-made, World War II-era M1 81mm mortar, and the self-propelled AMX-13 MOD.56 MORTIER (the same mortar weapon system, but mobile).
The new M108A2 was an ungodly combination of M113 components, early M109’s turret, and the M103’s 105mm gun, which the Americans phased out after the Vietnam War. The Belgians retained these vehicles in service much longer, only replacing them shortly before our time frame. Consider this a "poor man's Abbott". Having only been replaced recently in WARNO’s timeline, the unit is still considered a regular.
The rest of the DivMob’s artillery are all drawn from storage and receive the Reservist trait:
The M44A1, a 155mm open-top, medium-range self-propelled gun.
The M55, a fully armored medium-range 203mm SPG.
The towed M59 155mm, which is the venerable Long Tom of World War II fame.
The M115 203mm, this is the venerable World War II heavy towed M1 8-inch howitzer.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/847b1d38b64cfc9e09db3c14a53ea3fb4b3fe982.jpg

TANK
An average category, but with quite a few (older) choices in its arsenal.
Belgium held enough tanks in storage to equip several reserve tank companies of M41 (a single card) and M47 (two cards). The former, the ”Walker Bulldog” light tank had a quick-firing 76mm gun, while the latter “Patton” (a completely different design to the later M60 Patton) was equipped with a 90mm tank gun, which was by 1989 obsolete. Both feature the Reservist trait.
The Belgian Gendarmerie (former paramilitary police) could call on an armored squadron with the mission to escort the Belgian royal family in case of war, from the palace to evacuation by plane or boat. Having done their royal duty, they would commit to the fight. This formation was equipped with domestic-made armored cars looking suspiciously like AMLs, although better armored: the new FN 4RM/52F MiMo, armed with the same gun-mortar as the AML-60, plus the FN 4RM/62F ABC, armed with a CATI 90mm gun, slightly better than the one found on an AML-90. Both units receive the Military Police trait.
 Several anti-tank vehicles can also be deployed: JPK 90, the new AMX-13 MOD.56 MILAN (with a single MILAN 1 launcher), and the CRV(T) STRIKER. Also, some ILTIS MILAN 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/5d482918afa4d7d73c61e6cfd05abe7ef871dde0.jpg

REC
Average, with slots quickly becoming more expensive.
Infantry recon includes:
PATROUILLE PROV., which are 4-man squads with FALs, one FALO and LAW, in an ILTIS.
ECLAIREURS PROV., which are 6-man squads with FALs, one FALO and Blindicide RL-83, deployable in trucks and M75 AIV.
The SDRA 8. This unit represents Belgian cells from the infamous Gladio stay-behind network. Those operatives, disguised as civilians and having access to prepared hidden weapon caches, were envisioned to have any Warsaw Pact invasion bypass them, to then organize intelligence and sabotage missions in the rear. In Belgium, those weapon caches were mostly World War II leftovers, but with lots of explosives! In WARNO, they are featured as 10-strong recon squads with 3x MP-40, 6x M1 Carbine, 1x, Model 30-11 sniper rifles and satchel charges, with the Special Forces, Shock, and False Flag traits.
As mentioned with the 16de Pantserdivisie, the Belgian Armed Forces had bought a large number of the CRV(T) family of armored vehicles from the United Kingdom, enough to equip all their combat divisions’ recon regiments fully … and other units!
This means you’ll get to deploy more CRV(T) SCORPION and CRV(T) SCIMITAR.
Air recon units include:
ALOUETTE II unarmed helicopters.
The (new for this nation) CM.170 MAGISTER recon plane with rockets. Identical to the French 152e Division d’Infanterie (Nemesis - Plateau d'Albion), this aircraft is featured in this division in Belgian silver and red livery.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/3ab6d38b5225d54d3b69c09b0999e4016261d8c3.jpg

AA
Pretty good, with a balance between costs and options.
Belgian heavy SAM units field the ubiquitous I-HAWK, with the batteries themselves protected against low-flying air attacks by HSS.630-3 triple 20mm guns.
The only self-propelled AA gun is the MAN Z311 HSS.630-3, which is the above gun mounted on a truck.
Other towed units include the M55 MAXSON quad-12,7mm and the heavy BOFORS 57mm M/54, which the Belgians were the only ones to field outside of Sweden.
A single card of PARA. MISTRAL MANPAD teams with Forward Deployment.

HEL
Non-existent. There are no helicopters, nor cards, nor slots. The DivMob completely lacked any type of rotorcraft for support.

AIR
Average in terms of options, costs, and the availability of units.
You’ll get to fly the new payload variant of the ALPHA JET [HE] and HE2 with bombs.
The F-16A [AA] and the close air support F-16A [HE/CLU] will be both available, as well as the MIRAGE 5BA [CLU].

The DivMob is an unusual battlegroup in the sense that it is a heavily mechanized reserve division, wielding mostly obsolete equipment, and relying chiefly on its capable infantry and a significant number of artillery to make a difference on the battlefield.

We will soon return with a description of the Dutch CLKA. In the meantime, members of the Strike Team who have helped us testing these divisions will have the pleasure to stream them for you and tell you more about them.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

In the southern reaches of Germany, the Warsaw Pact with the Soviet Central Group of Forces, bolstered by the communist Czechoslovakians, battles against a counter-attacking NATO SOUTHAG command led by France, with American, West German, Canadian, and reinforcing Spanish troops.

2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or AttritionHydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.

Be assured that we are giving our outmost to release SOUTHAG as soon as possible. Have a look at those new units we have modeled after showcasing their respective division, and which haven't been shown so far:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/073e22adfae9e6c7a198864553d454e7f0dc3cf5.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/12c767935e59986a282d47dc37de431a56db39a7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/f6ef0eea0e8e9c3c9bafee62e21b33292c2843b4.png
Until Next Week
We’ll be back soon with another WARNO DevBlog!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

See you on the battlefield, commanders.

notes.title: SOUTHAG Army General #2 - Closing the Trap
notes.content:
Hello all!

In today’s DevBlog, we’ll look at the second Army General campaign to ship with WARNO - SOUTHAG: Closing the Trap.

Let’s go!

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Strategic Situation
As we mentioned in the DevBlog detailing the first Army General campaign - Holding Attack - the situation on the southern reaches of the front is relatively quiet compared to the heavier battles fought in CENTAG and NORTHAG. Some perfunctory Warsaw Pact attacks are easily contained, and while NATO re-institutes SOUTHAG, bringing ever more reinforcements, a plan is concocted to strike the communists where it is easy to regain the strategic initiative.

After beating back a Soviet-Czechoslovakian attack at Nuremberg, the NATO allies begin a campaign to first fix the Czechoslovak 1st Army in place (Holding Attack). The second phase of this campaign aims to attack across the flank of the Warsaw Pact - briefly breaking through the neutral borders of Austria - before taking the fight to the Czechoslovakians on their own territory. And this second phase of the strategic counter-attack is depicted in the Closing the Trap Army General campaign.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/63ef1b10a07b4dfbe1bd623ad9dd5f3736b89017.jpg

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Closing the Trap
The Closing the Trap campaign takes place after the Holding Attack campaign, but before the Hydra Operation. The West German II Korps, strengthened by the 1st Canadian Division, successfully engages and fixes as many Czechoslovak 1st Army units as possible along the Iron Curtain. With the communist attention in one place, NATO plays the ace up its sleeve.

NATO takes a gamble, and breaches briefly Austrian neutrality (despite the latter's official and vehemently issued complaints), surging its mobile French and Spanish task forces in a surprise move against the Czechoslovak flank. They brush aside second-rate Warsaw Pact units that guarded the supposedly calm sector.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/63deb413ec1174304e45e088920b3055a10c8359.png

Having outflanked the Czechoslovak 1st Army, on the defensive roughly following the Iron Curtain, NATO plays to win: they intend to race from south to north, parallel to the frontier, in order to encircle the whole of the Czechoslovak 1st Army before they can pull out from the West German-Canadian stranglehold. To speed things along, NATO drops the French 11e Division Parachutiste in two separate battlegroups, which aim to seize key crossroads in the rear and then - as the famous saying goes - “hold until relieved” by allied ground forces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/e45e69bbf8bc8218b0805f1444caa9dcb234a280.png

NATO’s daring mission on a strategic level is to link the two paratrooper pockets with the ground units quickly. If this is successful, the Czechoslovak 1st Army is effectively surrounded. Of course, the communists see the danger and rush in substantial reinforcements in a desperate bid to relieve their almost besieged friendly forces.

[previewyoutube=K9FPprxm_1Y;full](insérer vidéo Closing The Trap / Chaudron)[/previewyoutube]

The Campaign Itself
As with Holding Attack some of the divisions involved in this Army General campaign can be played in multiplayer, while others are only featured in the campaign itself.

NATO
On NATO’s side, we have a mix of French FAR (Force d'Action Rapide) and II. (FR) Corps, the Spanish Brunete armored division and elements from the West German II Korps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/0321089143df0493d8738fec93eb694c88232d83.jpg

The 6e Division Légère Blindée (a multiplayer division, featured in this DevBlog). The FAR’s tip of the spear, this division will be at the forefront of the offensive. As mentioned in previous DevBlogs, French Cold War divisions were notably smaller than other NATO ones, and this will clearly show in this Army General campaign. This French division will field about half the number of battalions compared to American or West German divisions, though these formations will be well-equipped and powerful on the battlefield.
The 4e Division Aéromobile. Among the already small French formations, this division is the smallest of them all, with just four battalions. This means it amounts to barely a brigade size by NATO standards. This French division fields three combat helicopter regiments (Gazelles) and an (oversized) airmobile infantry regiment.
The II (FR) Corps provides the French 3e Hussards (a powerful AMX-10RC recon regiment) and the 53e Régt. d'Artillerie (Roland) formations, acting in support of this spearhead. Each amounts to a single battalion.
The 5e Division Blindée (already in-game), also coming from II (FR) Corps. This French division follows closely behind, bringing some much-needed firepower, but only appearing later as reinforcements. This formation is larger than the 6e Division Légère Blindée, but still only features about two-thirds of the battalions of a similar NATO division.
Split in two pockets, the 11e Division Parachutiste holds the objectives from the start. The closest group of paratroopers threatens Plzeň and is sure to attract the enemy's full attention. It contains the airborne division’s professional regiments (2e REP, 8e RPIMa, 1er RHP, etc.) and is very solid in its defensive capabilities. The second group, further away, holds the reservist units and the HQ, and while in less immediate danger, will have to hold out longer before being able to be relieved.
More reinforcements will become available as the Army General campaign progresses, but you’ll have to choose between them: either the 24. Panzerbrigade (from 1. Gebirgs-Division, linking the French-Spanish enveloping troops with II. Korps across the border) or two Spanish brigades from the División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1 (as previewed in this DevBlog here). The former brings a few hard-hitting Leopard 2 tanks, backed by Panzergrenadiers; the latter features lighter battalions equipped with the M113 and AMX-30E.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/a0ffde636705adf5fd00dfbae1a996a4dc1608f2.jpg

Warsaw Pact
On the communist side, we have elements from both the Czechoslovak 1st and 2nd Army, plus some welcome reinforcements from the Soviet Group of Central Forces. At the start of the campaign, the Warsaw Pact’s troops on the ground are isolated forces from several dispersed formations, trying to establish roadblocks in front of those pesky Frenchmen rushing the battlefield from all directions: the south, the rear, the sky.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/ac02912f44fbb08959bb02009dbd6663f3113216.jpg

Directly facing the French onslaught from the south is a single battered Czechoslovak regiment from the 2nd Army’s 3. Motostřelecká Divize. Isolated from its parent formation further south, this regiment has been pushed back towards the 1st Army and is the main obstacle between the French and the first paratrooper pocket.
From the west, and thus the 1st Army’s direction, several individual - at times reinforced - regiments from divisions that call this army home (2. Motostřelecká Divize in the south, and the 20. Motostřelecká Divize in the north) have managed to extricate themselves from the West German and Canadian advance. They are either trying to contain NATO’s threat on their back, or recapture the crossroads held by the paratroopers.
In Plzeň itself, a motley combat group made up of security troops, elite paratroopers, SAM anti-air units, and 19. Motostřelecká Divize elements hold the town. These forces have prevented a successful coup de main from the French paratroopers.
Spread across various villages on the campaign map, a few security battalions can be used (or some say, sacrificed) to slow down the French advance. They could also be deployed to reinforce the individual regiments battling NATO in isolation. 

Salvation for the Czechoslovakians will less likely come from inside, but rather from outside friendly units. Powerful reinforcements have been sent to the front by the Warsaw Pact, arriving in force from the east to break the encirclement.

The Czechoslovak 9. Tanková Divize. Being the best of the 2nd Army, this division is roughly similar to the 1. Tanková Divize (which we previewed here). This particular formation arrives from the east, heading straight towards Plzeň. However, it won’t arrive immediately, so the few locally available troops need to hold out until this armored battlegroup arrives.
Shortly after the above, the Soviet 15-ya Tank. Diviziya will enter the battlefield, this time from further north. This particular division is equipped with T-72A and BMP-1s. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/a6c2769fbee86007814d0ebca39bc37f1db22659.jpg

It is a race
The Closing the Trap campaign is a race. For NATO, the main aim is to rush and encircle the entire Czechoslovak 1st Army before it can escape or be rescued. The opposite is true for the Warsaw Pact: they need to break out the 1st Army as soon as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d1926a787d7ea99a710a9a1835523c4ffd510333.jpg

If you have read closely, you might have realized it isn’t a race in exactly the same direction, but instead, at a 90-degree angle: NATO’s effort goes from south to north, while the Warsaw Pact races from east to west, in their effort to reopen communications with the 1st Army.

Both sides’ offensive movements within the campaign will intersect, usually around the two French paratrooper pockets. Neither NATO nor Warsaw Pact reinforcements are forced to take a straight line, so the big clash might happen anywhere on the campaign map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/5e34a3ea08d295865b875bca638d39ef9ed2caa0.jpg

If Holding Attack was mostly a West German/Canadian and Czechoslovakian affair, Closing the Trap gives prominence to the French and Czechoslovaks (again), with a beefier supporting role for Spanish and West German troops, and the Soviets for the communists.

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion In Short
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

In the southern reaches of Germany, the Warsaw Pact with the Soviet Central Group of Forces, bolstered by the communist Czechoslovakians, battles against a counter-attacking NATO SOUTHAG command led by France, with American, West German, Canadian, and reinforcing Spanish troops.

2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or AttritionHydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.

Until Next Week
As always, we’ll be back with another WARNO DevBlog in the near future!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

See you on the battlefield, commanders.

notes.title: SOUTHAG Army General #1 - Holding Attack
notes.content:
Hello commanders!

At long last, in today’s DevBlog, we will be able to share the very first (of two) Army General campaigns to be featured in WARNO - SOUTHAG.

What do we have in store for you with Army General’s Holding Attack?

Let’s find out!

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Strategic Situation
To recap: in WARNO - SOUTHAG, the Warsaw Pact sees the southern stretch of the Iron Curtain, from the CENTAG to the border with Austria, mainly as a secondary effort. The Czechoslovakian People’s Army (ČSLA) attacks across the frontier, into West Germany, but doesn’t advance much. The dallying communists are more than happy to fix local NATO units in place.

This gives NATO a chance to reform SOUTHAG under French command, and bring in reinforcements from its allies, including forward-deployed Canadian units, and mobile forces from Spain. It is a risky move, as in the north, the Warsaw Pact seems poised to break through.

[previewyoutube=SfRVIxwnvI8;full](insérer vidéo AG08_Fixation)[/previewyoutube]

Another opportunity is presented when the Soviet Group of Central forces opens up a new offensive axis towards Nuremberg, which gets crushed by a combined West German and American task force. This puts the communists in this theatre of war on the back heel.

Meanwhile, SOUTHAG command is cooking up a storm, and NATO plans to take the fight to the Warsaw Pact. This strategic counter-offensive will be the focus of WARNO - SOUTHAG’s two Army General campaigns. It will be played out in two distinct phases, of which the first is Holding Attack.

WARNO - SOUTHAG’s Holding Attack
Holding Attack is, chronologically, the first of the two Army General campaigns. In it, we focus on the West German and Canadian divisions fixing the Czechoslovak People’s Army’s 1st Army in front of Plzeň.

The Army General campaign will feature a number of divisions already presented as multiplayer-capable battlegroups. However, Army General will also contain some campaign-only divisions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/fe5bef611e964bcd8b50257e6b7216825979b652.jpg

NATO
On NATO’s side, you get to play with:
The 4.Panzergrenadier-Division is situated on the northern part of the Army General battlefield. This is a standard Bundeswehr Panzergrenadier division.
The 1. Luftlande-Division (as previewed in this DevBlog) holds the center. It is here that the terrain of Holding Attack is the most rugged. This formation also acts as a link between NATO’s two main mechanized divisions. The 1. Luftlande contains a very useful airmobile infantry battalion, which can be used as a mobile projection force.
The 10. Panzerdivision in the south, but still assembling. This means one of the division’s panzerbrigades has yet to arrive at the start of the Army General campaign. While the German II. Korps in SOUTHAG was the only one to be assigned a single Panzerdivision, this particular formation was special in the way it was the first to be entirely equipped with Leopard 2A4 across its three brigades. This makes it the most powerful Panzerdivisions of the Bundeswehr in the late 1980s.
The 1st Canadian Division, likewise, isn’t deployed at the beginning of the campaign, instead expected later as reinforcements. The formation includes the 4 CMBG (the powerful brigade deployed in West Germany), the 5 GBMC (the light air-transportable brigade from Quebec), as well as the 1 CMBG (a reservist brigade arriving last). The Canadian CF-188 squadrons are available as air support from the start.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/9cb9f1ebcdae20797e3162a11319798c7f696219.gif


Warsaw Pact
For the communists, from north to south, the following divisions will be available:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/701ab960c427e53e88faa22d360d218fe65b94cd.jpg

The 2. Motostřelecká Divize, which is a typical ČSLA motorized infantry division, modeled along Soviet lines.
The 19. Motostřelecká Divize (as previewed in a previous DevBlog).
The 20. Motostřelecká Divize, in the same vein as the formations mentioned above.
The 1. Tanková Divize (as previewed in this DevBlog) isn't deployed at the start, only arriving later as reinforcements from the east.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/06cffae6d6669416ddd8a40899836bf71616a4b1.gif


The three Motostřelecká divisions follow roughly the same structure with the 2. Motostřelecká Divize and the 20. Motostřelecká Divize featuring one BMP-1 and two OT-64-equipped infantry regiments, while the 19. Motostřelecká Divize has one BMP-1, one BMP-2, and one OT-64 regiment. All of these motorized infantry divisions field the T-55A as their main battle tank in their infantry regiment, while the improvised T-55AM-1 forms the backbone of the tank regiments in these divisions. The 1. Tanková Divize is equipped with T-72s and BMP-2s.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d3fb4165808adc1b7c6be26b168396d7107de453.png

The 2. Motostřelecká Divize and 20. Motostřelecká Divize occupy a wider front, while the 19. Motostřelecká Divize has a shorter stretch, but deploys more in depth, covering Plzeň to the rear. The Czechoslovakian city is furthermore garrisoned by security troops and the famous 22. Výsadkový Pluk, which are the ČSLA’s elite special forces airborne regiment, acting as the ultimate 1st Army reserve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d3e06979a2e658bf8e98ec8cc7d91f05aa69b841.jpg

The Campaign Itself
A special note, but Holding Attack is - for once - an Army General campaign that will not feature any US or Soviet troops. This is (mostly) a West German versus Czechoslovakian affair, with the Canadians lending a hand when they hear another “brawl” is happening in Czechoslovakia (of course, this is a reference to the infamous Canada-USSR "Punch-Up in Piestany" from 1987).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/d7e4db1aba1d01f2bc12453caaa0653158d4e8a0.png

Unlike most other Army General campaigns, where there are multiple far-away objectives, to be captured by rupturing the enemy front and breaking through, Holding Attack represents a grinding offensive. In this campaign, you need to repeatedly attack and erode the enemy’s will for resistance, and achieve victory through a slow but steady advance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/3d2bdc6961acb6d7930fd1399446dbc78aa5e45c.jpg

NATO’s goal is to secure the intermediate objectives within a given time frame. This should wear down (but also concentrate) the enemy in a specific number of locations, one by one. However, the ultimate price is the capture of Plzeň.

The Warsaw Pact will need to hold the outer defenses before falling back around Plzeň and “doing an Alamo.” Their hope is that the reinforcing 1 Tanková Divize would prove ultimately more reliable than Colonel Fannin in the aforementioned siege.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/f8a1e8884f1c88372457555678b10c102cf327c8.jpg

WARNO - SOUTHAG Expansion In Short
WARNO - SOUTHAG is WARNO’s second expansion after WARNO - NORTHAG and showcases the fighting in southern West Germany near the Alps and on the Czechoslovakian frontier.

In the southern reaches of Germany, the Warsaw Pact with the Soviet Central Group of Forces, bolstered by the communist Czechoslovakians, battles against a counter-attacking NATO SOUTHAG command led by France, with American, West German, Canadian, and reinforcing Spanish troops.

2 new Army General campaigns, including Holding Attack.
4 new Operations, such as Delayed Retribution, Glory or AttritionHydra
10 new Divisions, featuring Canada, Spain, and Czechoslovakia as new nations. These include NATO’s 1st Canadian Division, the Spanish División Mecanizada «Brunete» n.º 1, the French 6e Division Blindée Légère and Division du Rhin, plus the West German 1. Luftlandedivision. The Warsaw Pact features the Czechoslovakian 1. Tanková Divize, 19. Motostřelecká Divize, and 303. Tanková Divize, while the Soviet Central Group of Forces deploys the 31-ya Tankovaya Diviziya and the 17-ya Gvardeyskaya Tankovaya Diviziya.
New voice acting.
New units and models.

Until Next Week
As always, we’ll be back with another WARNO DevBlog in the near future!

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.

See you on the battlefield, commanders.

notes.title: Ranked: Season 2 Finale & Season 3 Preview
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,

We want to share with you the upcoming changes for Ranked mode and the next season.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/1fd930ff277cc2eeeeb942326b2613fd01c908bf.jpg"]

End of Season 2
Season 2 of Ranked will end on Monday, July 7th, 2025. A reset will take place on the same day to mark the beginning of Season 3. For the end of this season, we want to implement a system to preserve the results of previous seasons, highlighting your achievements and showcasing each season’s standout performances.
This system will be set up on our Discord server, where the Top 20 will be displayed, and we will do our best to include as many statistics as possible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/fa0374f502c64fd4b68b401c39718e3d42c6e1a8.gif"]

Season 3
For Season 3, we want you to vote for the maps that will be featured in the rotation.
The poll will run for one week. You can find it at the link just below.

Vote here!

The seven most voted maps will be included in the season. An eighth map, Ohmen Duel, will be added to the rotation without being part of the vote.
To remind you, Ohmen Duel is a new map specifically designed for 1v1 matches and features a mirrored layout. 
You can find more details in the DevBlog dedicated to this map : https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1611600/view/497193144876532432


What about the other game modes?
Our goal is to offer the best possible gaming experience to everyone, no matter your favorite game mode. We know that our community is diverse, including solo Army General players, multiplayer groups who only play 10v10 with friends, experienced ranked players, and many more.
Rest assured, we are not forgetting anyone. We will also be addressing topics and updates that affect players who do not play in ranked mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657262/4729d43d5c3cde883f2916d430759d15e542ecb8.png"]
What do you think about these upcoming changes to ranked play?
Feel free to share your thoughts or ask any questions, we’ll do our best to answer them.

Don’t forget the vibrant WARNO community. Check the latest news on the Steam News page or visit the Steam Forums. Get together with other players on either the excellent Discord server, Reddit page, YouTube or our Instagram.
